# Issue templates

- **Bug report.** A crash, a missed form, or a report that does not match the file.
- **Feature request.** Something the tool does not do. Check [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) first.
- **Enhancement.** A change to something it already does.
- **Documentation.** A doc that is wrong or missing.
- **Question.** Help running it. Longer threads belong in GitHub Discussions.
- **Performance.** A slow or stuck scan.
- **Security.** Sends you to private reporting. Do not describe a vulnerability in a public issue.

Blank issues are disabled. Vulnerabilities go to [the advisory form](https://github.com/Michael-A-Kuykendall/skiptrace/security/advisories/new) or to michaelallenkuykendall@gmail.com.
